alias: Heating: switch to Winter when the house cools
description: Heating stays off until it is needed: outside under 6 C for 6 hours, or the hallway under 19 C or the child's room under 18 C for 3 hours. Hot water keeps running in Winter mode.

data.title: Heating switched to Winter
data.message: Triggered by {{ trigger.id }}. Hallway {{ states('sensor.hallway_temperature') }} C, the child's room {{ states('sensor.childs_room_temperature') }} C, outside {{ states('sensor.heat_pump_outside_temp') }} C. The floor takes a day to warm up. Set the wall dial and leave it.
